postCredits.summaryBoth: Stay seated! There is a scene during the credits and another one at the very end.
postCredits.summaryMid: A bonus scene plays during the middle of the credits. You won't need to wait until the very end.
postCredits.summaryEnd: Stay until the very end! A bonus scene awaits you after the full credits roll.
postCredits.summaryNone: No bonus scene. You can leave the theater as soon as the credits start.
postCredits.summaryNoneShort: No post-credits scene listed for this film.
postCredits.summaryMarvel: Stay seated! Marvel films almost always have bonus scenes during and at the very end of the credits.
postCredits.summaryDC: Stay alert: DC films frequently include a bonus scene during the credits.
postCredits.summaryAnimation: A short bonus or funny animation is often shown during the first part of the credits.

welcome.slide1_desc: Your ultimate cinema companion. Explore live showtimes and access theaters instantly, even offline.
welcome.slide2_desc: Instantly filter by cinema, formats (IMAX, 3D, Dolby), audio versions (VOST/VF) or directors.
welcome.slide3_desc: Save your favorite movies without creating complex accounts and share picks with your friends.
welcome.slide4_desc: Locate local theaters across Lyon and export showtimes directly to your personal calendar with reminders.
welcome.slide5_desc: Store your tickets, track upcoming showtimes, and receive smart reminders so you never miss a movie.
welcome.slide_widget_desc: Glance at featured movies and today's showtimes right from your home screen without opening the app.
